text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: Ahem, ladies and gentlemen. We will now begin the Fukushima Prefecture Cultural Merit Ceremony.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: Appointed today as the Honorary Governor of Fukushima Prefecture for a day is—

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: It's Twin Turbo-san!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, thank you so much for the welcome!
Turbo's gonna go all-out on prefectural duty!

It was only natural she was named Governor for a Day.
Yes, Twin Turbo is truly—
Fukushima's golden child.
Beginning with the Tanabata Sho, she dominated numerous graded stakes races held at Fukushima Racecourse.
"She had now become a local celebrity Umamusume in Fukushima, beloved by all the residents of the prefecture."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Uhm, hello people of Fukushima!
It's Turbo!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: I practiced what to say a whole bunch today with my trainer.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I'm Turbo... I'm Turbo...
Turbo...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
—Memory wiped. As expected, making Turbo's brain memorize a whole speech was impossible.
However, anticipating this would happen, I made sure to instruct them to carry a memo.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Yes, yes, this is it...!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Is this paper from a game
of tic-tac-toe?
...I got careless at the very end. I should have checked to make sure I had the right paper in hand.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Umm, let's see...
Turbo is... Turbo is, you know...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Turbo loves Fukushima!

Twin Turbo gave up
and began explaining in her own words.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
At first, Turbo hated training so, so much.
So I came to Fukushima just to have fun!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
After that, running around everywhere was just
so much fun! Sightseeing was great,
and the scenery was beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: And I love food, too! Ramen, of course. Peaches, too. Oh, and stir-fried squid and carrots is great as well.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: And best of all...!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
The racecourse! When Turbo's at Fukushima,
I can run at full throttle without thinkin' about anything at all!!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
It's undoubtedly the best course in the world!
That's why...!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Lately, Turbo's been having a dream.
Someday... just you wait and see...!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: I want to hold a GⅠ in Fukushima!
(Oooooohh!!)

Those were not prepared words.
They were feelings that spilled right out
from the bottom of Twin Turbo's heart.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I want to show the people of Fukushima even more amazing
Umamusume. And among them...!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo is gonna wiiin!!!
A runaway wire-to-wire wiiin!!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Because Turbo is number one in Fukushima!
After all, Turbo's the prefectural governor!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo will keep giving it her all as an Umamusume
so she can keep winning awards from Fukushima!!
The end!
(WOOOOAAAHH!!)

"...The crowd erupted into massive cheers.
Because her words were so straightforward, it really showed just how much Twin Turbo loves Fukushima."

Bringing a GⅠ race to Fukushima.
Aiming for that new dream...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Fufun. Hey, Trainer.
Just now, I came up with a name for the race.
The name is—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: The Twin Turbo Stakes!

—The dream "Twin Turbo Cup."
To establish a race bearing her own name at Fukushima,
Twin Turbo will keep blasting full speed ahead.
